name: Government of the Republic of Tatarstan
via: constituent republic of the Russian Federation; sole shareholder of AO Svyazinvestneftekhim, the republic's state holding company
note: Tatarstan's state holding Svyazinvestneftekhim holds 27.23% of Tatneft's charter capital (29.07% of voting shares), and the Republic holds a 'golden share' over Tatneft under Tatneft's Articles of Association.
